description: Tokens gage admits as collateral now: each one's minimum pledge, its most per loan where one is set (maxPerLoan, null where there is none), whether leverage buys it, how many partner vaults lend against it now (vaults: 0 means none does yet, null that gage's index cannot say), a stock's display multiplier (uiMultiplier; amounts here are raw) and its Borrow link on gage.cash; a row names the lend asset it is borrowed in, once there is more than USDG.
name: gage_assets
title: Collateral gage takes
